items.category: build-integrity defect in the guard added in Phase 3
items.evidence: the manuscript builder ran the placeholder guard on the file left on disk before rendering the new Markdown into it, so a clean previous file licensed a dirty build and a dirty previous file blocked a clean one; the companion builder guarded after writing, so an abort left the bad file in place. This is the mechanism behind the n/a episode recorded in Phase 3, whose diagnosis was incomplete
items.action: manuscript: render to a temporary file, guard that, then atomically replace - a failing build leaves the last good document untouched; companion: restore the previous bytes before re-raising. Phase 3 REPORT section 7 carries an amendment pointing here
